name: com.bookgather/bookgather
title: BookGather
description: Find author events (signings, library talks, festivals) and authors available for bookings.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find upcoming author events listed on BookGather: book signings, readings, library and bookstore author events, book festivals and online author talks. Filter by keywords, place and date. Returns title, date (UTC), location, cost and the event page link.

query.description: Keywords that must all appear in the title, description or tags, e.g. 'romance signing' or an author's name.

location.description: City, state code or venue name to match in the event location, e.g. 'Dallas', 'WA', 'Seattle'.

from_date.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full details for one BookGather event by its slug (the last part of its bookgather.com/events/ link).

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Find authors on BookGather by name, genre or location. Set bookable_only to list authors who accept bookings for school visits, library programs, book clubs, signings, festivals or virtual visits, with their posted fee range. Returns genres, books, booking details and the profile link where a host can send a booking request.

location.description: City or state the author is based in.

bookable_only.description: Only authors who have marked themselves available for bookings.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: Full public profile for one BookGather author by slug (the last part of their bookgather.com/authors/ link): bio, books, genres, booking terms and upcoming events.
